mapper.insert: insert into a2a_reconciliation_cases() values(#{value.tenantId},#{value.caseId},#{value.requestId},#{value.cancellationId},#{value.childTaskId},#{value.dispatchRequestId},#{value.resultId},#{value.handoffSnapshotId},#{value.caseType},#{value.status},#{value.authorityOwner},#{value.reasonCode},#{value.reason},#{value.diagnosisCode},#{value.evidenceSummary},#{value.evidenceSnapshotHash},#{value.recommendedAction},#{value.repairAction},#{value.requiredPermission},#{value.impactSummary},#{value.planHash},#{value.expectedResourceVersion},#{value.attemptCount},#{value.repairAttemptNo},#{value.idempotencyKey},#{value.claimedBy},#{value.claimTokenHash},#{value.claimUntil},#{value.heartbeatAt},#{value.nextAttemptAt},#{value.lastErrorCode},#{value.lastError},#{value.repairEvidenceId},#{value.resolvedBy},#{value.resolutionReason},coalesce(#{value.createdAt},now()),coalesce(#{value.updatedAt},now()),#{value.resolvedAt},#{value.version}) mapper.update: update a2a_reconciliation_cases set status=#{value.status},authority_owner=#{value.authorityOwner},diagnosis_code=#{value.diagnosisCode},evidence_snapshot_hash=#{value.evidenceSnapshotHash},repair_action=#{value.repairAction},required_permission=#{value.requiredPermission},impact_summary=#{value.impactSummary},plan_hash=#{value.planHash},expected_resource_version=#{value.expectedResourceVersion},attempt_count=#{value.attemptCount},repair_attempt_no=#{value.repairAttemptNo},idempotency_key=#{value.idempotencyKey},claimed_by=#{value.claimedBy},claim_token_hash=#{value.claimTokenHash},claim_until=#{value.claimUntil},heartbeat_at=#{value.heartbeatAt},next_attempt_at=#{value.nextAttemptAt},last_error_code=#{value.lastErrorCode},last_error=#{value.lastError},repair_evidence_id=#{value.repairEvidenceId},resolved_by=#{value.resolvedBy},resolution_reason=#{value.resolutionReason},updated_at=#{value.updatedAt},resolved_at=#{value.resolvedAt},version=#{value.version} where tenant_id=#{value.tenantId} and case_id=#{value.caseId} and version=#{expectedVersion}
mapper.select: select * from a2a_reconciliation_cases where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and case_id=#{caseId}

select * from a2a_reconciliation_cases where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and cancellation_id=#{cancellationId} and status in('OPEN','READY','CLAIMED','EXECUTING','RETRY_WAITING','WAIT_HUMAN') order by created_at desc limit 1

select * from a2a_reconciliation_cases where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and a2a_request_id=#{requestId} and status in('OPEN','READY','CLAIMED','EXECUTING','RETRY_WAITING','WAIT_HUMAN') order by created_at desc limit 1
select * from a2a_reconciliation_cases where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and status in('OPEN','READY','CLAIMED','EXECUTING','RETRY_WAITING','WAIT_HUMAN') order by created_at desc limit #{limit}

with due as (select tenant_id,case_id from a2a_reconciliation_cases where status in('OPEN','READY','RETRY_WAITING','CLAIMED','EXECUTING') and coalesce(next_attempt_at,created_at)<=#{now} and (claim_until is null or claim_until<=#{now}) order by coalesce(next_attempt_at,created_at),created_at for update skip locked limit #{limit}), claimed as (update a2a_reconciliation_cases c set status='CLAIMED',claimed_by=#{workerId},claim_token_hash=md5(c.case_id||':'||#{workerId}||':'||clock_timestamp()::text),claim_until=#{claimUntil},heartbeat_at=#{now},repair_attempt_no=c.repair_attempt_no+1,updated_at=#{now},version=c.version+1 from due where c.tenant_id=due.tenant_id and c.case_id=due.case_id returning c.*) select * from claimed

with due as (select tenant_id,case_id from a2a_reconciliation_cases where status='READY' and (claim_until is null or claim_until<=#{now}) order by updated_at,created_at for update skip locked limit #{limit}), claimed as (update a2a_reconciliation_cases c set status='EXECUTING',claimed_by=#{workerId},claim_token_hash=md5(c.case_id||':'||#{workerId}||':'||clock_timestamp()::text)||md5('p2i:'||c.case_id||':'||#{workerId}||':'||clock_timestamp()::text),claim_until=#{claimUntil},heartbeat_at=#{now},repair_attempt_no=c.repair_attempt_no+1,updated_at=#{now},version=c.version+1 from due where c.tenant_id=due.tenant_id and c.case_id=due.case_id returning c.*) select * from claimed
mapper.update: update a2a_reconciliation_cases set heartbeat_at=#{heartbeatAt},claim_until=#{claimUntil},updated_at=#{heartbeatAt},version=version+1 where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and case_id=#{caseId} and claimed_by=#{workerId} and version=#{expectedVersion} and status in('CLAIMED','EXECUTING')
mapper.sql: tenant_id=#{tenantId} and status=#{status} and case_type=#{caseType} and authority_owner=#{authorityOwner} and a2a_request_id=#{requestId} and (case_id ilike concat('%',#{text},'%') or a2a_request_id ilike concat('%',#{text},'%') or reason_code ilike concat('%',#{text},'%') or diagnosis_code ilike concat('%',#{text},'%'))
mapper.select: select * from a2a_reconciliation_cases where order by updated_at ${sortDirection} nulls last,created_at ${sortDirection} offset #{offset} limit #{limit}
